newsitem.title: USA: GPU shuts N.J. Oyster Creek nuclear plant.
newsitem.headline: GPU shuts N.J. Oyster Creek nuclear plant.

text.p: General Public Utilities Corp's 610 megawatt (MW) Oyster Creek nuclear power plant was shut Friday to correct a problem with the unit's generator, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Monday.
The plant, at Forked River, N.J., was being brought back into service when it was again shut down.
According GPU's report to the NRC, the plant's reactor was manually scrammed, or shut, following a combination of problems with the main generator and a stator cooling water system.
The plant, owned by GPU, had been running at full capacity prior to the outage.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment and it was not known how long the unit was likely to be off line.
